dialogue.text: Moo's magical bell, once upon a time, in a peaceful farm nestled between rolling emerald hills, lived a kind and curious cow named Moo.
dialogue.zh: 從前，在一座坐落於翠綠山丘間的寧靜農場裡，住著一隻善良又好奇的牛，名叫Moo。
dialogue.ja: 昔々、緑の丘に囲まれた平和な農場に、親切で好奇心旺盛な牛のムーが住んでいました。
dialogue.local: Moo's magical bell, once upon a time, in a peaceful farm nestled between rolling emerald hills, lived a kind and curious cow named Moo.
dialogue.en: Moo's magical bell, once upon a time, in a peaceful farm nestled between rolling emerald hills, lived a kind and curious cow named Moo.

dialogue.text: Moo had big, gentle eyes, a golden coat, and the sweetest heart.
dialogue.zh: Moo有著大而溫柔的眼睛、金色的皮毛和最甜美的心靈。
dialogue.ja: ムーは大きくて優しい目を持ち、黄金色の毛並みと一番優しい心を持っていました。
dialogue.local: Moo had big, gentle eyes, a golden coat, and the sweetest heart.
dialogue.en: Moo had big, gentle eyes, a golden coat, and the sweetest heart.

dialogue.text: She loved her friends dearly, but she had one secret wish.
dialogue.zh: 她非常愛她的朋友們，但她有一個秘密願望。
dialogue.ja: 彼女は友達をとても大切にしていましたが、一つ秘密の願いがありました。
dialogue.local: She loved her friends dearly, but she had one secret wish.
dialogue.en: She loved her friends dearly, but she had one secret wish.

dialogue.text: She wore an old rusty bell around her neck, clink, clink, it went.
dialogue.zh: 她脖子上掛著一個又舊又生鏽的鈴鐺，叮噹叮噹地響著。
dialogue.ja: 彼女は首に古くて錆びた鈴をつけていて、チリンチリンと鳴っていました。
dialogue.local: She wore an old rusty bell around her neck, clink, clink, it went.
dialogue.en: She wore an old rusty bell around her neck, clink, clink, it went.

dialogue.text: His old bell is so boring, Moo sighed one sunny morning.
dialogue.zh: 「這個舊鈴鐺真無聊，」Moo在一個晴朗的早晨嘆氣說。
dialogue.ja: 「この古い鈴はつまらないな」と、ムーは晴れた朝にため息をつきました。
dialogue.local: His old bell is so boring, Moo sighed one sunny morning.
dialogue.en: His old bell is so boring, Moo sighed one sunny morning.

dialogue.text: If only it were magical, imagine the wonderful things I could do.
dialogue.zh: 如果它是魔法鈴鐺就好了，想像我能做多麼美妙的事情。
dialogue.ja: もしこれが魔法の鈴だったら、素敵なことがたくさんできるのにと思いました。
dialogue.local: If only it were magical, imagine the wonderful things I could do.
dialogue.en: If only it were magical, imagine the wonderful things I could do.

dialogue.text: Suddenly, a joyful chime echoed in the air.
dialogue.zh: 突然，一聲歡快的鈴聲在空氣中迴盪。
dialogue.ja: 突然、楽しい鈴の音が空気に響き渡りました。
dialogue.local: Suddenly, a joyful chime echoed in the air.
dialogue.en: Suddenly, a joyful chime echoed in the air.

dialogue.text: Moo's rusty bell began to shimmer and glow with bright golden light, a tiny fairy with sparkling crystal wings appeared.
dialogue.zh: Moo生鏽的鈴鐺開始閃爍發出明亮的金光，一位擁有閃耀水晶翅膀的小仙子出現了。
dialogue.ja: ムーの錆びた鈴が輝き始め、明るい黄金色の光を放ち、小さな妖精がキラキラした水晶の翼を持って現れました。
dialogue.local: Moo's rusty bell began to shimmer and glow with bright golden light, a tiny fairy with sparkling crystal wings appeared.
dialogue.en: Moo's rusty bell began to shimmer and glow with bright golden light, a tiny fairy with sparkling crystal wings appeared.

dialogue.text: Treatings Moo, the fairy cheered, because you are so kind and full of wonderful dreams, I have a special gift for you.
dialogue.zh: 仙子對Moo歡呼說，因為你如此善良且充滿美好的夢想，我有一份特別的禮物給你。
dialogue.ja: 妖精はムーに言いました。「あなたはとても優しくて素敵な夢を持っているから、特別な贈り物をあげます。」
dialogue.local: Treatings Moo, the fairy cheered, because you are so kind and full of wonderful dreams, I have a special gift for you.
dialogue.en: Treatings Moo, the fairy cheered, because you are so kind and full of wonderful dreams, I have a special gift for you.

dialogue.text: This bell is now magic.
dialogue.zh: 這個鈴鐺現在是魔法鈴鐺了。
dialogue.ja: この鈴は今や魔法の鈴です。
dialogue.local: This bell is now magic.
dialogue.en: This bell is now magic.

dialogue.text: Ring it once, and any wish will be granted.
dialogue.zh: 搖響它一次，任何願望都會實現。
dialogue.ja: 一度鳴らせば、どんな願いも叶います。
dialogue.local: Ring it once, and any wish will be granted.
dialogue.en: Ring it once, and any wish will be granted.

dialogue.text: But remember, magic is powerful.
dialogue.zh: 但請記住，魔法是強大的力量。
dialogue.ja: でも覚えておいてください、魔法は強力なものです。
dialogue.local: But remember, magic is powerful.
dialogue.en: But remember, magic is powerful.

dialogue.text: Use it wisely.
dialogue.zh: 要明智地使用它。
dialogue.ja: 賢く使いなさい。
dialogue.local: Use it wisely.
dialogue.en: Use it wisely.

dialogue.text: As the fairy vanished, Moo danced with excitement.
dialogue.zh: 仙子消失後，Moo興奮地跳起舞來。
dialogue.ja: 妖精が消えると、ムーは興奮して踊り出しました。
dialogue.local: As the fairy vanished, Moo danced with excitement.
dialogue.en: As the fairy vanished, Moo danced with excitement.

dialogue.text: She shook her bell and said, I wish for the tastiest, yummiest grass in the whole wide world.
dialogue.zh: 她搖了搖鈴鐺說，我希望擁有全世界最好吃、最美味的草。
dialogue.ja: 彼女は鈴を鳴らして言いました。「世界で一番美味しい草が欲しいです。」
dialogue.local: She shook her bell and said, I wish for the tastiest, yummiest grass in the whole wide world.
dialogue.en: She shook her bell and said, I wish for the tastiest, yummiest grass in the whole wide world.

dialogue.text: Jingle, instantly, the ordinary grass transformed into lush, juicy, emerald grass.
dialogue.zh: 叮噹一聲，普通的草立刻變成了茂盛多汁的翡翠綠草。
dialogue.ja: チリンと鳴ると、普通の草が一瞬で青々としたジューシーなエメラルドグリーンの草に変わりました。
dialogue.local: Jingle, instantly, the ordinary grass transformed into lush, juicy, emerald grass.
dialogue.en: Jingle, instantly, the ordinary grass transformed into lush, juicy, emerald grass.

dialogue.text: Moo took a bite.
dialogue.zh: Moo咬了一口。
dialogue.ja: ムーは一口かじりました。
dialogue.local: Moo took a bite.
dialogue.en: Moo took a bite.

dialogue.text: Mmm, this is grass-tastic.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，這草真是太棒了。
dialogue.ja: うーん、これは草のごちそうだ。
dialogue.local: Mmm, this is grass-tastic.
dialogue.en: Mmm, this is grass-tastic.

dialogue.text: The next morning, Moo saw her friend, cheeky the squirrel, looking incredibly sad.
dialogue.zh: 隔天早上，Moo看到她的朋友，調皮的松鼠，看起來非常難過。
dialogue.ja: 翌朝、ムーは友達のいたずらリスのチーキーがとても悲しそうにしているのを見ました。
dialogue.local: The next morning, Moo saw her friend, cheeky the squirrel, looking incredibly sad.
dialogue.en: The next morning, Moo saw her friend, cheeky the squirrel, looking incredibly sad.

dialogue.text: All the acorns I saved for winter are gone, cheeky sniffled.
dialogue.zh: 我為冬天存的所有橡果都不見了，Cheeky抽泣著說。
dialogue.ja: 冬のために取っておいたどんぐりが全部なくなったと、チーキーはすすり泣きました。
dialogue.local: All the acorns I saved for winter are gone, cheeky sniffled.
dialogue.en: All the acorns I saved for winter are gone, cheeky sniffled.

dialogue.text: What am I going to eat?
dialogue.zh: 我該吃什麼呢？
dialogue.ja: 何を食べればいいんだろう？
dialogue.local: What am I going to eat?
dialogue.en: What am I going to eat?

dialogue.text: Moo's kind heart couldn't stand seeing her friend upset.
dialogue.zh: Moo善良的心無法忍受看到朋友難過。
dialogue.ja: ムーの優しい心は、友達が悲しむのを見るのが耐えられませんでした。
dialogue.local: Moo's kind heart couldn't stand seeing her friend upset.
dialogue.en: Moo's kind heart couldn't stand seeing her friend upset.

dialogue.text: She shook her magic bell.
dialogue.zh: 她搖了搖她的魔法鈴鐺。
dialogue.ja: 彼女は魔法の鈴を鳴らしました。
dialogue.local: She shook her magic bell.
dialogue.en: She shook her magic bell.

dialogue.text: I wish for a massive pile of acorns for cheeky.
dialogue.zh: 我希望有一大堆橡果給Cheeky。
dialogue.ja: チーキーのために大量のどんぐりが欲しいです。
dialogue.local: I wish for a massive pile of acorns for cheeky.
dialogue.en: I wish for a massive pile of acorns for cheeky.

dialogue.text: Jingle, acorns rained down, creating a giant, delicious mountain, cheeky jumped for joy.
dialogue.zh: 叮噹一聲，橡果如雨般落下，堆成一座巨大的美味山丘，Cheeky高興地跳了起來。
dialogue.ja: チリンと鳴ると、どんぐりが雨のように降り注ぎ、大きくて美味しそうな山ができ、チーキーは喜んで飛び跳ねました。
dialogue.local: Jingle, acorns rained down, creating a giant, delicious mountain, cheeky jumped for joy.
dialogue.en: Jingle, acorns rained down, creating a giant, delicious mountain, cheeky jumped for joy.

dialogue.text: Moo realized something important, helping her friends felt even better than making a wish for herself.
dialogue.zh: Moo意識到一件重要的事，幫助朋友比為自己許願還要快樂。
dialogue.ja: ムーは大切なことに気づきました。自分のために願いを叶えるよりも、友達を助ける方がもっと嬉しいと感じたのです。
dialogue.local: Moo realized something important, helping her friends felt even better than making a wish for herself.
dialogue.en: Moo realized something important, helping her friends felt even better than making a wish for herself.

dialogue.text: Later, Moo found Dooku, the duck, and her chicks, crying beside a dried-up pond.
dialogue.zh: 後來，Moo發現鴨子Dooku和她的小鴨們在乾涸的池塘邊哭泣。
dialogue.ja: その後、ムーはアヒルのドゥークとそのヒナたちが干上がった池のそばで泣いているのを見つけました。
dialogue.local: Later, Moo found Dooku, the duck, and her chicks, crying beside a dried-up pond.
dialogue.en: Later, Moo found Dooku, the duck, and her chicks, crying beside a dried-up pond.

dialogue.text: Do not worry, my feathered friends, Moo said, she rang her bell.
dialogue.zh: 別擔心，我的羽毛朋友們，Moo說著搖響了鈴鐺。
dialogue.ja: 心配しないで、羽の友達たちよ、とムーは言い、鈴を鳴らしました。
dialogue.local: Do not worry, my feathered friends, Moo said, she rang her bell.
dialogue.en: Do not worry, my feathered friends, Moo said, she rang her bell.

dialogue.text: I wish for a cool, sparkling pond.
dialogue.zh: 我希望有一個涼爽閃亮的池塘。
dialogue.ja: 涼しくてキラキラした池が欲しいです。
dialogue.local: I wish for a cool, sparkling pond.
dialogue.en: I wish for a cool, sparkling pond.

dialogue.text: Water burst from the ground, and the ducks happily dove in.
dialogue.zh: 水從地面湧出，鴨子們快樂地跳入水中。
dialogue.ja: 水が地面から湧き出し、アヒルたちは嬉しそうに飛び込みました。
dialogue.local: Water burst from the ground, and the ducks happily dove in.
dialogue.en: Water burst from the ground, and the ducks happily dove in.

dialogue.text: Next, Moo gave Rusty the old dog a giant leafy tree for shade, and created a soft bed of golden hay for the tired farm horses.
dialogue.zh: 接著，Moo給了老狗Rusty一棵巨大的樹蔭，並為疲憊的農場馬匹準備了柔軟的金色乾草床。
dialogue.ja: 次に、ムーは老犬ラスティに大きな葉の木陰を与え、疲れた農場の馬たちには柔らかい黄金の干し草のベッドを作りました。
dialogue.local: Next, Moo gave Rusty the old dog a giant leafy tree for shade, and created a soft bed of golden hay for the tired farm horses.
dialogue.en: Next, Moo gave Rusty the old dog a giant leafy tree for shade, and created a soft bed of golden hay for the tired farm horses.

dialogue.text: Moo had discovered the greatest magic of all, the joy of giving.
dialogue.zh: Moo發現了最偉大的魔法，那就是付出的喜悅。
dialogue.ja: ムーは最高の魔法、与える喜びを見つけました。
dialogue.local: Moo had discovered the greatest magic of all, the joy of giving.
dialogue.en: Moo had discovered the greatest magic of all, the joy of giving.

dialogue.text: However, sneaky, clucky the rooster was watching.
dialogue.zh: 然而，狡猾的公雞Clucky正在偷看著。
dialogue.ja: しかし、ずる賢い雄鶏のクラッキーが見ていました。
dialogue.local: However, sneaky, clucky the rooster was watching.
dialogue.en: However, sneaky, clucky the rooster was watching.

dialogue.text: Why should Moo have all the fun?
dialogue.zh: 為什麼Moo可以獨享所有樂趣？
dialogue.ja: なぜムーだけが楽しめるの？
dialogue.local: Why should Moo have all the fun?
dialogue.en: Why should Moo have all the fun?

dialogue.text: He muttered, while Moo was napping, clucky grabbed the bell.
dialogue.zh: 他喃喃自語著，趁Moo午睡時，Clucky搶走了鈴鐺。
dialogue.ja: 彼はつぶやきました。ムーが昼寝している間に、クラッキーは鈴を奪いました。
dialogue.local: He muttered, while Moo was napping, clucky grabbed the bell.
dialogue.en: He muttered, while Moo was napping, clucky grabbed the bell.

dialogue.text: I wish for the biggest cornfield in the world, just for me.
dialogue.zh: 我希望擁有世界上最大的玉米田，只屬於我。
dialogue.ja: 世界で一番大きなトウモロコシ畑が欲しい、僕だけのために。
dialogue.local: I wish for the biggest cornfield in the world, just for me.
dialogue.en: I wish for the biggest cornfield in the world, just for me.

dialogue.text: Boom!
dialogue.zh: 轟！
dialogue.ja: ドーン！
dialogue.local: Boom!
dialogue.en: Boom!

dialogue.text: The gentle meadows and the barn vanished.
dialogue.zh: 溫柔的草地和穀倉消失了。
dialogue.ja: 穏やかな牧草地と納屋が消えてしまいました。
dialogue.local: The gentle meadows and the barn vanished.
dialogue.en: The gentle meadows and the barn vanished.

dialogue.text: The entire farm turned into an endless sea of towering thick cornstocks.
dialogue.zh: 整個農場變成了一片無盡的高大濃密玉米田。
dialogue.ja: 農場全体が高くて太いトウモロコシの海に変わりました。
dialogue.local: The entire farm turned into an endless sea of towering thick cornstocks.
dialogue.en: The entire farm turned into an endless sea of towering thick cornstocks.

dialogue.text: I am the king of corn, clucky crowed, but soon chaos struck.
dialogue.zh: 我是玉米之王，Clucky高聲叫道，但很快混亂發生了。
dialogue.ja: 僕はトウモロコシの王様だとクラッキーは鳴きましたが、すぐに混乱が起きました。
dialogue.local: I am the king of corn, clucky crowed, but soon chaos struck.
dialogue.en: I am the king of corn, clucky crowed, but soon chaos struck.

dialogue.text: The sheep bumped into the thick stalks, and clucky got completely lost.
dialogue.zh: 羊群撞上了濃密的玉米莖，Clucky完全迷路了。
dialogue.ja: 羊たちは太い茎にぶつかり、クラッキーは完全に迷子になりました。
dialogue.local: The sheep bumped into the thick stalks, and clucky got completely lost.
dialogue.en: The sheep bumped into the thick stalks, and clucky got completely lost.

dialogue.text: Wait, this is too much corn, he panicked.
dialogue.zh: 等等，這玉米太多了，他慌了起來。
dialogue.ja: 待って、これはトウモロコシが多すぎる、と彼は慌てました。
dialogue.local: Wait, this is too much corn, he panicked.
dialogue.en: Wait, this is too much corn, he panicked.

dialogue.text: Moo woke up and found him, clucky handed the bell back in shame.
dialogue.zh: Moo醒來找到他，Clucky羞愧地把鈴鐺還回來。
dialogue.ja: ムーは目を覚まして彼を見つけ、クラッキーは恥ずかしそうに鈴を返しました。
dialogue.local: Moo woke up and found him, clucky handed the bell back in shame.
dialogue.en: Moo woke up and found him, clucky handed the bell back in shame.

dialogue.text: Moo shook it one last time.
dialogue.zh: Moo最後搖了搖鈴鐺。
dialogue.ja: ムーは最後にもう一度鈴を鳴らしました。
dialogue.local: Moo shook it one last time.
dialogue.en: Moo shook it one last time.

dialogue.text: I wish for our farm to go back to normal.
dialogue.zh: 我希望我們的農場恢復原狀。
dialogue.ja: 農場が元に戻りますように。
dialogue.local: I wish for our farm to go back to normal.
dialogue.en: I wish for our farm to go back to normal.

dialogue.text: Woosh!
dialogue.zh: 呼！
dialogue.ja: シュッ！
dialogue.local: Woosh!
dialogue.en: Woosh!

dialogue.text: A golden light swept away the cornstocks.
dialogue.zh: 一道金光掃除了玉米莖。
dialogue.ja: 黄金の光がトウモロコシの茎を一掃しました。
dialogue.local: A golden light swept away the cornstocks.
dialogue.en: A golden light swept away the cornstocks.

dialogue.text: The barn reappeared, and everything was perfect once more.
dialogue.zh: 穀倉重新出現，一切又恢復了完美。
dialogue.ja: 納屋が再び現れ、すべてが元通り完璧になりました。
dialogue.local: The barn reappeared, and everything was perfect once more.
dialogue.en: The barn reappeared, and everything was perfect once more.

dialogue.text: I am so sorry, Moo, clucky apologized.
dialogue.zh: 對不起，Moo，Clucky道歉說。
dialogue.ja: ごめんなさい、ムー、とクラッキーは謝りました。
dialogue.local: I am so sorry, Moo, clucky apologized.
dialogue.en: I am so sorry, Moo, clucky apologized.

dialogue.text: It's okay, clucky.
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，Clucky。
dialogue.ja: 大丈夫だよ、クラッキー。
dialogue.local: It's okay, clucky.
dialogue.en: It's okay, clucky.

dialogue.text: Moo smiled.
dialogue.zh: Moo微笑著。
dialogue.ja: ムーは微笑みました。
dialogue.local: Moo smiled.
dialogue.en: Moo smiled.

dialogue.text: Just remember, too much of a good thing isn't always good at all.
dialogue.zh: 只要記得，過猶不及並非好事。
dialogue.ja: ただ覚えておいて、良いこともやりすぎはよくないよ。
dialogue.local: Just remember, too much of a good thing isn't always good at all.
dialogue.en: Just remember, too much of a good thing isn't always good at all.

dialogue.text: As the sun set, the glowing fairy reappeared.
dialogue.zh: 夕陽西下，發光的仙子再次出現。
dialogue.ja: 夕日が沈むと、輝く妖精が再び現れました。
dialogue.local: As the sun set, the glowing fairy reappeared.
dialogue.en: As the sun set, the glowing fairy reappeared.

dialogue.text: Moo, you used your magic incredibly well.
dialogue.zh: Moo，你用魔法非常棒。
dialogue.ja: ムー、あなたは魔法をとても上手に使いましたね。
dialogue.local: Moo, you used your magic incredibly well.
dialogue.en: Moo, you used your magic incredibly well.

dialogue.text: Your kind heart is the greatest magic of all.
dialogue.zh: 你善良的心是最偉大的魔法。
dialogue.ja: あなたの優しい心こそが最高の魔法です。
dialogue.local: Your kind heart is the greatest magic of all.
dialogue.en: Your kind heart is the greatest magic of all.

dialogue.text: The bell will no longer grant wishes, but it will always ring to remind you of the beauty of kindness.
dialogue.zh: 鈴鐺將不再實現願望，但它會永遠響起，提醒你善良的美麗。
dialogue.ja: 鈴はもう願いを叶えませんが、優しさの美しさを思い出させるためにいつも鳴り続けます。
dialogue.local: The bell will no longer grant wishes, but it will always ring to remind you of the beauty of kindness.
dialogue.en: The bell will no longer grant wishes, but it will always ring to remind you of the beauty of kindness.

dialogue.text: The fairy faded away.
dialogue.zh: 仙子漸漸消失了。
dialogue.ja: 妖精は消えていきました。
dialogue.local: The fairy faded away.
dialogue.en: The fairy faded away.

dialogue.text: Moo walked happily across the meadow, her bell jingling a sweet, peaceful melody, reminding everyone that the real magic in life is helping those you love.
dialogue.zh: Moo快樂地走過草地，鈴鐺響起甜美和平靜的旋律，提醒大家生命中真正的魔法是幫助你所愛的人。
dialogue.ja: ムーは幸せそうに草原を歩き、鈴は甘く穏やかなメロディーを鳴らし、人生の本当の魔法は愛する人を助けることだとみんなに思い出させました。
dialogue.local: Moo walked happily across the meadow, her bell jingling a sweet, peaceful melody, reminding everyone that the real magic in life is helping those you love.
dialogue.en: Moo walked happily across the meadow, her bell jingling a sweet, peaceful melody, reminding everyone that the real magic in life is helping those you love.

dialogue.text: Did you enjoy Moo's magical adventure?
dialogue.zh: 你喜歡Moo的魔法冒險故事嗎？
dialogue.ja: ムーの魔法の冒険は楽しめましたか？
dialogue.local: Did you enjoy Moo's magical adventure?
dialogue.en: Did you enjoy Moo's magical adventure?

dialogue.text: If you loved this story about kindness, please give this video a huge thumbs up.
dialogue.zh: 如果你喜歡這個關於善良的故事，請給這個影片一個大大的讚。
dialogue.ja: この優しさの物語が気に入ったら、この動画に大きないいねをお願いします。
dialogue.local: If you loved this story about kindness, please give this video a huge thumbs up.
dialogue.en: If you loved this story about kindness, please give this video a huge thumbs up.

dialogue.text: Share it with your friends and hit that subscribe button for more wonderful stories.
dialogue.zh: 與你的朋友分享並按下訂閱鈕，獲取更多精彩故事。
dialogue.ja: 友達と共有して、もっと素敵な物語のためにチャンネル登録ボタンを押してください。
dialogue.local: Share it with your friends and hit that subscribe button for more wonderful stories.
dialogue.en: Share it with your friends and hit that subscribe button for more wonderful stories.

dialogue.text: Let us know in the comments what you would wish for.
dialogue.zh: 在留言區告訴我們你會許什麼願望。
dialogue.ja: コメントであなたが何を願いたいか教えてください。
dialogue.local: Let us know in the comments what you would wish for.
dialogue.en: Let us know in the comments what you would wish for.

dialogue.text: See you next time!
dialogue.zh: 下次見！
dialogue.ja: また次回お会いしましょう！
dialogue.local: See you next time!
dialogue.en: See you next time!
